zh.explain: 木雕的老虎在富贵人家的门口立着，虽然有威风，却不会害人。明知是没有妨害的，为什么还要迟疑恐惧，忧心忡忡。
divination: 犹如炉火上面的一点雪花，或是耳旁的一阵风，虽然看似有些危害，却会自然消于无形。所以应当往好处想，一切都会解决，前面貌似凶险，而结果则会很吉利。
items: 继续坚持努力，将获更大成就
zh.summary: 此卦木虎有威之象。所祈求之事会虚惊一场，而不会有实质性的危害。

verse: A wooden tiger stands at the gate,
Fierce it may look but harm it will not inflict.
Worries, fears and suspicions are all unfounded.
interpretation: Snowflakes on a hot stove, winds that brushed against the ears, things will pass quickly.
You should do more good deeds and fortune will soon follow despite your earlier mishaps.
meaning: A wooden tiger statue just looks fierce and imposing.
There are false alarms as not much is real.
en.explain: A wooden tiger stands at the front door of a wealthy house. Although it looks imposing and ferocious, it is harmless. Since there is no threat of danger, why worry, fear, be suspicious and afraid.
divination: Like some snowflakes falling onto a hot stove or a gust of wind in the ear, although the outlook seems dangerous, it will disappear naturally. Thus, think positively, and problems will be resolved. What appears to be dangerous. the outcome will eventually be auspicious.
items: Although face difficulties, it can be overcomed
Continue to work hard and get greater achievements

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en key printed 'Academic & examination' (ampersand). Printed typos kept: 'dangerous. the outcome' (period + lowercase), 'overcomed', 'need to recuperated well'. zh shiyi line 1 ends with 。 as printed.
